name: stage-links
why: Links into and out of a stage with children. Into it (FS from Design, SS+2 from Long-lead steel) anchor on hidden Start(B). Out of it, FS and FF anchor on hidden Finish(B), SS on Start(B). Indices are Mon-Fri from Mon 1 Mar 2027 with no holidays.

A.why: FS into Start(B): LF = LS of Start(B) 3 - 0 = 3. FF = ES of Start(B) 3 - 3 = 0.

E.why: SS+2 into Start(B): result 0 + 2 = 2 < 3, not driving. LF = LS of Start(B) 3 - 2 + D_E 6 = 7. FF = 3 - 2 = 1.

B.why: Start(B) ES = max(0, A FS 3, E SS+2 2) = 3. Bar spans children: es min(3, 5) = 3, ef max(5, 9) = 9; ls min(3, 5) = 3, lf max(5, 9) = 9; tf least child float 0; ff of Finish(B) = min(C: 9 - 9, F: 5 - 5) = 0. Index 8 = Thu 11 Mar.

b1.why: Held by Start(B) at 3. LF = min(PF 11, b2: LS 5, Finish(B): 9) = 5.

b2.why: max(Start(B) 3, b1 FS 5) = 5. LF = LF of Finish(B) = min(PF 11, C FS: LS 9 - 0, F FF: LF 11 + 1 = 12) = 9.

C.why: FS out of B anchors on Finish(B) = 9.

D.why: SS+1 out of B anchors on Start(B): 3 + 1 = 4. LF = PF 11.

F.why: FF-1 out of B anchors on Finish(B): 9 - 1 - 3 = 5. LF = PF 11.
